fields.label: Completed Personal Accident Claim Form
fields.summary: Submit the completed claim form.

fields.label: Attending Physician’s Statement or Medical Certificate
fields.summary: Provide statement or certificate from the attending physician.

fields.label: Police Investigation Report or Statement of Witness/es
fields.summary: Include report or statement from police or witnesses.

fields.label: Valid IDs of the Insured and Beneficiary
fields.summary: Present actual IDs and submit photocopies; at least one must be government-issued.

fields.label: Birth Certificate
fields.summary: Submit the birth certificate issued by PSA or Local Civil Registry.

fields.label: Death Certificate with Post-Mortem Examination
fields.summary: Provide death certificate issued by PSA or Local Civil Registry.

fields.label: Official Receipts of Medical Expenses
fields.summary: Submit receipts for medical expenses incurred.

fields.label: Photocopy of Hospital Records (if available)
fields.summary: Include photocopies of hospital records if available.

fields.label: Marriage Certificate (if applicable)
fields.summary: Provide marriage certificate if applicable.

fields.label: Official Receipts of Burial and Funeral Services
fields.summary: Submit receipts for burial and funeral services if claiming under accidental burial expense coverage.

fields.label: Photocopy of Contract of Burial and Funeral Services
fields.summary: Include photocopy of the burial and funeral services contract.

fields.label: Autopsy Report (if available)
fields.summary: Provide autopsy report if available.

fields.label: Complete Medical Records
fields.summary: Submit complete medical records showing proof of disability.

fields.label: Photos of amputated/aﬀected body parts of the Insured
fields.summary: Include photos of affected body parts, both whole body and close-up shots.

fields.label: Statement of Account (SOA) with Admission and Discharge Date
fields.summary: Provide statement of account with admission and discharge dates.
